title: Patch: every Classic+ card drawn as what it is: a scene of its own for each, richer the rarer
notes: Classic+'s picture pass (#3330, #3331's foundation). Every Classic+ entry, its 38 tokens included, draws from a scene recipe of its own, from a brief per card, in Classic's temple-stone look, base and Radiant (R3390000): a Common one clear subject in a simple setting, a Rare its props, an Epic a scene with a foreground, a middle and a background, a Legendary or Mythic every layer. Each humanoid Unit is a figure dressed as who it is, four Units are drawn as a creature or a machine (the Snake, the Book Worm, the J15 Fighter, the Mulch Muncher), a scene may stand crowds and companions as figures and mark props that move on a full-art card's props beat, and the figure kit and the scene kit grow by the parts the briefs name. All 116 entries clear their rarity's detail floor and leave the short list, whose cap falls to 445 (R3331001). How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Every Classic+ card drawn as a scene
changes: Every Classic+ card and token now shows a scene of its own, more detailed the rarer it is: its Units as the characters they are, its Spells as real places and moments.
